description: The pip route for OpenWebUI: create and activate a virtual environment, install the package, and start the server.

steps.description: This is the pip route, the second way to install OpenWebUI. The page says the install downloads a large dependency set, and the last command starts the server in your terminal, which you leave open.
`python3 -m venv owui` creates a virtual environment named `owui`.
`source owui/bin/activate` turns the environment on. In PowerShell the command is `.\owui\Scripts\Activate.ps1`.
`python3 -m pip install open-webui` installs OpenWebUI into that environment.
`open-webui serve` starts the server. The page says when the startup banner shows `Uvicorn running on http://0.0.0.0:8080`, the server is up.
